text: E on sikku, onon muumini en, on naatay aljanna hara on jarriboraaka sugu jarrabuyee yawtunooɓe on? Sabu ɓen meeɗuno saɗteende baasal e ñawu, ɓe dilliniraa kulol haa ɓe hawjiri ballal Alla ngal. Nulaaɗo on e gomɗindimɓe e makko ɓen mbi'i: "ko honnde tuma woni balla Alla ngal?". Hey, pellet ballal Alla ngal no ɓadii muumini en, fawiiɓe e Makko.
